verdict.rationale: Recurring or scheduled automations, such as recurring buys, are a fair question for a crypto payments platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no user-configurable automation or schedule. The headless Buy frame 'drives the buy pipeline in the background' only for a one-off, user-initiated transaction. Webhooks and the self-driving challenge frame are adjacent building blocks, not autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
